_comment: Inclusive Education -- Early Childhood Education Teachers' Diploma syllabus. First
typeset 2026-10-12. Layout, spelling and NUMBERING repairs only: none of these rewrites
a competence, an activity or an expected standard.
NUMBERING (2026-10-12, at the typesetter's request). The Year 1 matrix numbered two
topics 1.3, so every topic after Legal Frameworks was one behind -- behind the
manuscript's own Scope and Sequence Chart, and behind its own competences, most of
which already carried the right topic number (1.4.x.x under Learning in Diversity,
1.5.x.x under Differentiated Communication, 1.6.3 under Teaching Methodologies). The
second 1.3 and the six topics after it move up one (1.4 ... 1.10), which also closes
the gap before 1.11 Action Research; their sub-topics follow, and each competence takes
the number of the sub-topic it sits beside. See cellSubtext below for every change.
Two of those are a judgement, not arithmetic:
* 'Examine strategies that assist in managing different behaviours' (typed 1.7.2.1)
is 1.8.1.1, under 1.8.1 Managing Inclusive Classroom;
* 'Evaluate existing assigned inclusive schools' (typed 1.8.1.2) is 1.8.2.1, under
1.8.2 Inclusive School and classroom administrative practices.
STILL OUTSTANDING -- needs the author, not the typesetter:
* Action Research is topic 1.11 in the matrix but sub-topic 1.10.3 (under Assistive
Technology) in the Scope and Sequence Chart. The chart is left as written.
* The chart's sub-topic lists are a shorter summary and do not match the matrix one
for one (e.g. it has no Developmental domains, so its 1.4.1 is the matrix's 1.4.2).
* Sub-topics with no competence of their own: 1.2.2 (it shares a row with 1.2.1, whose
one competence is numbered 1.2.1.1), 1.4.2 (the Learning in Diversity row runs
* Learning in Diversity is ONE matrix row holding four sub-topics, six competences and all
their activities and standards, so it runs over a page break; splitting it means
deciding which activity belongs to which competence.
* 1.8.3 Facilitators and Barriers: the first two activities are the same sentence
('Discussing in groups to Identify barriers to Inclusive Education'); the first was
presumably meant to read 'facilitators'. Left as written.
* Possible slips left as written: 'Apply specify strategies' (1.6.1.1), 'budding system'
(twice, 1.6.1), 'Human Rights Mode of Disability' (1.1.4), 'Describing the effects of
Inclusive Education' under climate change (2.2.5).
* Assessment: TOTAL 100% and PASS MARK 40% are typed once, after Year Two.
* Time Allocation reads '2 hours per week / Year 1: - (36 weeks) / Year 2: - (12 weeks)'.
* No ISBN yet.

Rebuilt as one two-column grid per year with the manuscript's own wording, order and figures ('1 test 10' given its % sign). The last line is a marker for removeRange below, which takes out the manuscript's own copy.
